findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice short questions for Chapter 2 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Computer Science Board shape (8 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 53 questions numbered 1-53; by section: 2.1 4, 2.2 7, 2.3 4, 2.4 6, 2.5 5, 2.6 4, 2.7 5, 2.8 5, 2.9 5, 2.10 4, 2.11 4.

Covers every section in book order; every "difference" answer is a two-column table; answers are 2-4 lines or a small truth table. None repeats the chapter exercise (what is computational thinking, its importance, decomposition, algorithm, logic in computer science, proposition, truth values, truth table, satisfiability and predicate are left to the exercise; questions here take other angles). Every truth table, equivalence and satisfiability answer was computed in Python from the chapter's AND, OR, NOT rules.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
